This week is all about caramelised white chocolate, so a quick reminder on how to make it (full guide coming tomorrow on the newsletter)  1. Use real white chocolate that’s made with around 30% cocoa butter (prevents it going grainy) 2. Roast it low and slow, 120C for about an hour 3. Stir it VERY well every 15 mins, otherwise it can burn and turn grainy 4. Roast it until the colour is similar to dulce de leche  - #caramelisedwhitechocolate #roastedwhitechocolate #chocolatetips
